summary: Frontend test of Receipt Search on the law-office merchant portal at 390x844. mer-1 was set to law_office for the test, and 7 signed delivered stops (TSRS100-106) were seeded across Sep 15, Oct 27 and Nov 3, 2025. Everything was cleaned up afterwards and the original mer-1 document was restored. All 18 scripted search cases passed. Search ignores case and matches part of a client name (johnson, JOHN, smi), part of a tracking code (tsrs10, TSRS103), the shown date (Oct 27, Nov 3, Sep 15, 'Oct 27, 2025'), ISO dates (2025-10-27, 2025-11), 27/10/2025, 10/27/2025, and month names (october, OCTOBER, november, september, Sept). Spaces before and after the search are ignored. The 'N OF 7 MATCH' count is correct. 'No receipts match “zzzz”.' shows when nothing matches. While searching, all matches show with no 5-row cap and the SHOW ALL toggle is hidden. Clearing the search brings back 5 rows and SHOW ALL 7. The PDF button on a filtered row (Grace Wong, which is beyond the 5-row cap) requested receipt.pdf and the green 'RECEIPT DOWNLOADING' toast appeared; fetching a fresh link via curl returned 200 application/pdf. DOWNLOAD ALL 7 (ZIP) still shows 7 while filtered, and its link returned a 200 zip with 7 PDFs. There were no page errors. Gaps found: the search is a single substring match, so natural queries that combine words fail.

ui_bugs.issue: The needle is matched as one substring against the joined text. Queries that combine fields or use another word order return 0 results: 'October 27', '27 Oct', 'Oct 27 2025' (no comma), 'johnson oct', '2025-10-27 alice', 'Alice  Johnson' (double space), '2025/10/27'. Suggested fix: split the needle on whitespace and commas and require every word to appear (AND match), and collapse repeated spaces. Also add a 'month day' form (e.g. 'october 27') and a 'day month' form (e.g. '27 oct') to searchText. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ReceiptArchive.tsx:44-45,80-86

searchText includes the time from when() ('11:10 a.m.'), so number queries pick up unrelated rows. '11' matched Alice (Oct 27, 11:10 a.m.) as well as the Nov receipts. '10' matched all 7. 'p.m.' matched 4. Consider leaving the time out of the searchable text. Reference: ReceiptArchive.tsx:85

issues: At 390px the placeholder 'Search client, tracking code or date (e.g. Oct 27)' is cut off at '(e.g'. Shorten it, e.g. 'Client, code or date'.

If SHOW ALL was on before searching, clearing the search keeps all 7 rows. This is acceptable because the toggle state is kept, but note that 'clearing restores 5 rows' only holds when SHOW ALL was off.
There is no clear (x) button on web or Android. clearButtonMode only works on iOS.

action_items: MEDIUM: Make receipt search match every word: needle.split(/[\s,]+/).filter(Boolean).every(t => text.includes(t)). Add 'month day' and 'day month' date forms so 'October 27', '27 Oct', 'Oct 27 2025' and 'johnson oct' work.
LOW: Leave the time of day out of searchText so number queries ('11', '10') don't match on the hour.
LOW: Shorten the search placeholder so it fits at 390px. Optionally add a clear button for web and Android.
critical_code_review_comments: ReceiptArchive.tsx: searchText() is recomputed for every row on every keystroke, using several Intl calls per row (up to 500 rows). Memoize it with useMemo over q.data.receipts.
No search loading or error state is needed (client-side filter). The q.isError state for the receipts query is still not shown: the card returns null when there is an error.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested scenarios (18/18 search cases, PDF on filtered row, ZIP, toggle hide/restore); additional natural-language date and multi-word queries fail

seed_data_creation: Temporary seed: mer-1 business_type=law_office plus 7 TSRS1xx signed delivered stops. All removed afterwards and the mer-1 document restored to its original state (business_type and signature_required unset).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seed approach: snapshot mer-1, set business_type=law_office, and insert stops directly with merchant_id=mer-1, status=delivered, pod_signature set, route_id=None and delivered_at at midday UTC so the Toronto date is unambiguous. Restore with replace_one from the snapshot. The PDF and ZIP open via window.open with about:blank and then navigate to a download, so capture context requests for receipt.pdf / receipts.zip instead of the popup URL.
